verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own AI Editor lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts, which is a direct but narrow natural-language control surface. Nothing shows natural-language operation of the wider platform, such as controls, risks, audits, access reviews or vendors. Other AI features (evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence) and the GitHub compliance skills for coding agents are not natural-language commands that operate Sprinto, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: natural-language command interface across the core platform (assistant or chat to run compliance tasks), documentation of AI Editor depth and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
